title: Size Transferability of Graph Transformers with Convolutional Positional Encodings
abstract: arXiv:2602.15239v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transformers have achieved remarkable success across domains, motivating the rise of Graph Transformers (GTs) as attention-based architectures for graph-structured data. A key design choice in GTs is the use of Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based positional encodings to incorporate structural information. In this work, we study GTs through the lens of manifold limit models for graph sequences and establish a theoretical connection between GTs with GNN positional encodings and Manifold Neural Networks (MNNs). Building on transferability results for GNNs under manifold convergence, we show that GTs inherit transferability guarantees from their positional encodings. In particular, GTs trained on small graphs provably generalize to larger graphs under mild assumptions. translated_title: 具有卷积位置编码的图Transformer的尺寸可迁移性
translated_abstract: Transformer在各个领域取得了显著的成功，这推动了图Transformer（GTs）作为基于注意力机制的图结构数据处理架构的兴起。GT的一个关键设计选择是使用基于图神经网络（GNN）的位置编码来引入结构信息。在这项工作中，我们通过图序列的流形极限模型的视角研究GT，并建立了带有GNN位置编码的GT与流形神经网络（MNNs）之间的理论联系。基于流形收敛下GNN的可迁移性结果，我们证明了GT可以继承其位置编码的可迁移性保证。特别是，在小图上训练的GT在温和的假设下可以证明地泛化到更大的图。我们通过在标准图基准上进行大量实验来补充我们的理论，证明GT表现出与GNN相当的可扩展行为。
tldr: 本文建立了带有GNN位置编码的图Transformer与流形神经网络之间的理论联系，从理论上证明了在小图上训练的图Transformer在温和假设下能够泛化到更大的图，并通过实验验证了其与GNN相当的可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a theoretical connection between Graph Transformers with GNN positional encodings and Manifold Neural Networks, proving that GTs trained on small graphs provably generalize to larger graphs under mild assumptions, with experiments demonstrating scalability on par with GNNs.
